structure.unit: Regulation of Rates for Certain Types of Insurance
Rate Filings and Making of Rates

law.catch_line: Information regarding rates to be furnished insured
law.text: Each rate service organization and each insurer subject to this chapter that makes its own rates shall furnish to any insured affected by those rates, or to the authorized representative of the insured, all pertinent information regarding the rate within a reasonable time after receiving a written request for the information.
